svg.title: Kanban Cadences
svg.desc: A3 landscape board: eight Kanban cadences with typical timings and fields for when, who, inputs and outputs, plus replenishment and service delivery review panels.
svg.text: Set a rhythm of short, focused meetings that keep work flowing and services improving, with or without iterations.
